units.text: A λ-term is an expression in the lambda calculus, and a translation maps it into another formal representation.
The translations in this claim are well-formed translations of λ-terms.
requires: the meaning of a well-formed λ-term translation

units.text: In well-formed λ-term translations, active replicators at the same structural level are equal.
requires: the definition of an active replicator
